additional_concerns: The e-Cert claim's uncertainty is resolved by the whole packet: footnote 3 is anchored to both XML submission (da12aecad4e68.u4.1003) and prescribed PDF upload (da12aecad4e68.u5.1078), not the web form. This requirement does not itself define a resubmission trigger.

The temporal alternatives remain unresolved: da12aecad4e68.u3.811 says “With effect from 2 February 2026”, da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 specifies launch at 9:00am, and da12aecad4e68.u28.3334 says “following its implementation”. node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes pre-9:00am filings on that date; the other candidates select operational launch. Neither alternative should silently replace the question's retained alternatives.

The governing timezone and treatment of the exact implementation instant are not expressly established. The timezone authority is missing; an externally supplied temporal classification does not resolve the interpretive choice by itself.

The packet does not supply JFIU's separate XML schema or promised resubmission guidance. Its four opaque missing dependency IDs have no descriptions, so mapping them to particular authorities would be speculative.

Actual blackout-period submissions must remain distinct from mere urgent contact. The urgent-contact provision neither makes every contact a submission nor conclusively resolves whether a pre-launch submission triggers later resubmission.

The history candidate delegates event quantification and history completeness to an external Boolean. Its false result requires sufficient history; a later STREAMS 2 filing cannot erase the existence of an earlier triggering event. Whether the duty has been discharged is a different question.

The event candidates differ on non-submissions: node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb can return FALSE, while the other event candidates return OUT_OF_SCOPE. This matters if assessed inputs include attempted contact; the typed unit is an original submission event.

TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must be interpreted consistently with DUTY_TRIGGER: TRUE indicates a trigger, not fulfilled resubmission or general compliance. No candidate establishes permission to use other channels merely because a resubmission trigger is false.
